title: Claude Haiku 5.5 / xhigh effort
description: A white pelican with a long pale-yellow beak, an orange throat pouch, gray wings, and orange legs riding a red bicycle with black tires and white spokes under hazy, washed-out lighting; a rectangular slab outline and box-shaped shadows show on the ground.

unmetRequirements.evidence: Each view shows a pale rectangular platform outline on the ground around the bicycle, and level views 03-06 and raised views 01-02 cast large box-shaped shadows with streaked interiors, much wider than the rider. wheel(), frameG() and riderG() (lines 100-101, 114-115, 160-161) return bounding-box distances as geometry; the wheel boxes reach y -0.025 below the ground (RA/FA y 0.595, half-extent 0.62), and shadow() and calcAO() (lines 214-235) march those proxies.

warnings: The neck, tires and spokes show contour-ring banding in close-01 and close-02.
